rules.statement: The value of the subject-matter of a possessory action for the purpose of jurisdiction when the suit is brought by a lessee is not the value of the unexpired term of the lease, but the value of the land itself.
rules.supporting_quote: "The value of the subject-matter of a possessory action for the purpose of jurisdiction when the suit is brought by a lessee is not the value of the unexpired term of the lease, but the value of the land itself."
